rounds: v1: silhouettes and initial tile placement
v2: wider negative spaces, optical placement and consistent lighting

C.notes: Intentional rightward optical correction for the F; a letter has a narrower bounding box than the radial helm.

audit_note: Scores are structural heuristics, not a guarantee of design quality or distinctiveness.

observations.A: Strong continuity and much higher mark/background contrast; wheel detail remains denser at 16 px.
observations.B: The widened diagonal gap keeps the two forms separate. The silhouette can also suggest an S.
observations.C: The simplest silhouette at small sizes; recognition shifts to the initial rather than the nautical symbol.

recommendation: A for an evolutionary update of the existing Ferryx icon.
